component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.target = m.top.findNode("target") m.dlg = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.global.addFields({ probeArr: [], probeStr: "" })
p("control", caseControl()) p("m-scope-roundtrip", caseMScopeRoundtrip()) p("callfunc-plain", caseCallFuncPlain()) p("callfunc-mscope", caseCallFuncMScope()) p("field-custom-array", caseFieldCustomArray()) p("field-dialog-buttons", caseFieldDialogButtons()) p("global-field-array", caseGlobalFieldArray()) p("global-field-str-then-array", caseGlobalFieldStringThenArray()) p("tr-hit-raw", caseTrHitRaw()) p("tr-miss-raw", caseTrMissRaw()) p("tr-hit-plain", caseTrHitPlain()) p("tr-miss-plain", caseTrMissPlain()) p("tr-hit-callfunc", caseTrHitCallFunc()) p("tr-miss-callfunc", caseTrMissCallFunc())
' The Task case is deferred to a Timer tick: creating the Task and calling callFunc on it ' synchronously inline here, before the render thread's message loop ever yields, risks a ' deadlock (the Task's worker thread never gets a chance to spin up and service the ' rendezvous). Yielding via the Timer avoids that. m.taskTimer = m.top.findNode("taskTimer") m.taskTimer.observeField("fire", "onTaskTimer") m.taskTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onTaskTimer(event as object) task = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbeTask") task.control = "run" p("callfunc-task", caseCallFuncTask(task))
print "PROBE|999|all|done|" m.top.probeExit = true end sub
' A fresh, non-literal string each time - stands in for tr()'s runtime-computed return value. function nonLiteral() as string return ucase("probe string") end function
function makeArr() as object arr = [] arr.push(nonLiteral()) return arr end function
function describe(v as dynamic) as string return type(v) + "|" + type(v, 3) + "|" + v end function
' A: plain local array, plain local function call - no `m`, no node crossing at all. function caseControl() as string arr = makeArr() return plainReceive(arr) end function
function plainReceive(arr as object) as string return describe(arr[0]) end function
' B: array built from an undeclared `m.xxx` script-scope property, read back locally. ' Mirrors `m.favoritesOptionText = tr(...) : dialogData.push(m.favoritesOptionText)` with no ' callFunc crossing yet, to isolate whether the `m.` round-trip alone promotes the string. function caseMScopeRoundtrip() as string m.loose = nonLiteral() arr = [] arr.push(m.loose) return describe(arr[0]) end function
' C: plain array (no `m.` step) crossed via callFunc to a sibling non-Task node. function caseCallFuncPlain() as string arr = makeArr() return m.target.callFunc("receiveArgs", arr) end function
' D: the exact AlbumView.openMorePopup shape - `m.`-scope property, pushed, THEN callFunc. function caseCallFuncMScope() as string m.loose2 = nonLiteral() arr = [] arr.push(m.loose2) return m.target.callFunc("receiveArgs", arr) end function
' E: a declared XML `type="array"` interface field, set then read back (no callFunc). function caseFieldCustomArray() as string arr = makeArr() m.target.arrField = arr back = m.target.arrField return describe(back[0]) end function
' F: the built-in Dialog node's own "buttons" field - the exact field jellyfin-roku assigns. function caseFieldDialogButtons() as string arr = makeArr() m.dlg.buttons = arr back = m.dlg.buttons return describe(back[0]) end function
' G: an `m.global`-added array-typed field, set then read back. function caseGlobalFieldArray() as string arr = makeArr() m.global.probeArr = arr back = m.global.probeArr return describe(back[0]) end function
' H: an `m.global` STRING field (scalar, not array), set/read, then pushed into a fresh array. function caseGlobalFieldStringThenArray() as string m.global.probeStr = nonLiteral() s = m.global.probeStr arr = [] arr.push(s) return describe(arr[0]) end function
' I: plain array crossed via callFunc to a genuine Task (real cross-thread rendezvous). function caseCallFuncTask(task as object) as string arr = makeArr() return task.callFunc("receiveArgs", arr) end function
' J/K: tr() called directly, no array/callFunc - isolates the return value's own boxing. function caseTrHitRaw() as string return describe(tr("Hit Key")) end function
function caseTrMissRaw() as string return describe(tr("Miss Key Not In Table")) end function
' L/M: tr() result pushed into a local array, no callFunc. function caseTrHitPlain() as string arr = [] arr.push(tr("Hit Key")) return describe(arr[0]) end function
function caseTrMissPlain() as string arr = [] arr.push(tr("Miss Key Not In Table")) return describe(arr[0]) end function
' N/O: tr() result pushed into an array crossed via callFunc - the exact AlbumView shape, ' but with the real tr() global instead of the ucase() stand-in. function caseTrHitCallFunc() as string arr = [] arr.push(tr("Hit Key")) return m.target.callFunc("receiveArgs", arr) end function
function caseTrMissCallFunc() as string arr = [] arr.push(tr("Miss Key Not In Table")) return m.target.callFunc("receiveArgs", arr) end function
sub p(caseId as string, result as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + caseId + "|" + result end sub
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
